event/stream.
Routing and dispatch

classify() reads argv and repo configs, never runs them: session > container >
headless, plus a refuse flag. run() refuses that on every lane, and a forced
headless downgrade, else calls the lane's run(). Cloud: a box's ≤25 s claim
long-poll takes a waiting sandbox first, else the fairest task.

Source: src/router/index.ts; src/cli/api.ts; cloud/src/api/app.ts;
cloud/src/core/queue.ts
Where results and state live

Local: each run gets .offstage/runs/<id>/ (command.log, screen.png,
result.json); a failed write adds a diagnostic, never changes the verdict. Plane:
in-memory stores snapshot atomically to /data/plane.json every 2 s if changed
and on SIGTERM; in-flight sandbox ops are lost on restart.

Source: src/contract/artifacts.ts; src/cli/api.ts; cloud/src/server.ts;
cloud/src/core/persist.ts; cloud/Dockerfile
Failure and isolation

Missing substrate → skipped with a fix, never your screen. sessiond checks
peer uid and refuses input on-console. Unstarted claims requeue; started work
on a lost box fails. No claim without LAN guard; dirty slots reset to a new uid;
slots get a run token, not the model key.

Outside this view: Clerk sign-in, Stripe billing, Resend mail and GitHub App runner registration (plane); Fleet upkeep: fleetd reconcile, slot seeding via loopback VNC, recordings, fleet doctor; Marketing site (Vercel), launch film, bench and chaos tooling:
not runtime.
